title: Gridfinity Utensil Dividers (1x3 base)
author: TheGreenGozlin
description:
**Gridfinity 1x3 Utensil Holder**:

Upgrade your kitchen or workspace organization with this versatile Gridfinity utensil holder. Designed with a 1x3 base, it features evenly spaced slots, each 17mm wide, perfectly tailored to hold a variety of cooking utensils, art supplies, or any other tools you can imagine. The design includes two slots per 1x3 base, giving you the freedom to print multiple units and arrange them however you like for a fully customizable setup. Whether you're tidying up your kitchen or streamlining your workspace, this sleek and functional holder has you covered!
